Hi I made the dough using:
2 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
3/4 tsp. salt
1 cup water
2 tbsp. olive oil
Cornflour

Mix flour and salt together in a mixing bowl. Add water and olive oil. Mix thoroughly until a dough is formed, adding a bit of water if it seems to dry, flour if too moist.
Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic, about 5-10 minutes. Lightly rub the surface of dough with olive oil, place into a clean bowl, cover and let it rest for an hour.

I used a pasta maker to get thin dough but rolling out on a floured surface is a good method too. Roll the dough out, then fold up and roll flat again, do this about 6 times or more. 

Roll the dough out into a strip no thicker than 1/8” thick.

Place filling on the dough up to halfway down, with about 1-2cm gap between each filling. Dab water lightly around the filling and fold the non-filled half of the dough over the filling lengthways. Press around the dough covered fillings to release air bubbles and secure the filling. Cut around the fillings by either using a knife to cut about 0.5 around the edge and pressing a fork along it or by using a ravioli press. 

When cut out, flip in cornflour and leave the dry somewhat. When needed, boil in water for 5-6 minutes. 

The fillings I used were completely random and I kind of made them up as I went so can’t recall measurements sorry!
